title: Pushable Blocks
description: Datapack That Allows you to Summon Pushable Blocks With Collisions
body:
This Datapack adds Pushable Blocks. These blocks can be pushed by players and have collsions meaning you can push them up against walls and you can stand on them.

To summon a pushable block do /function pb:summonpushableblock
(Default is Iron Block)

Kill Commands: /function pb:killall - (Kills all Pushable Blocks), /function pb:killnearest - (Kills nearest block)

Rotation Reset: /function pb:resetrotation - (Resets Rotation of Blocks in case of Glitch)
